coach_advice: Warning: Aggressive deficit. ~1,279 kcal with only 75 g protein (0.8 g/kg vs 1.6–2.0 g/kg target). Food minus exercise leaves only ~642 kcal (before BMR). Add a protein-rich solid meal and a third protein feeding.

CRITICAL ALERT: Crash deficit (<1,000 kcal). ~945 kcal and 66 g protein. Severe risk of gym weakness, muscle catabolism and metabolic slowdown. Skipping dinner leaves the body without amino acids during sleep — eat a balanced dinner 60–90 min before the gym and keep the post-gym feed light (whey isolate / egg whites).

• Correct your 2,101 kcal deficit (TDEE 2,971 − intake 870 kcal) immediately, as 870 kcal is a crash level that risks muscle and strength loss; target 2,170–2,270 kcal daily for an aggressive 700–800 kcal deficit.
• Increase daily protein from today's 63.1 g (0.67 g/kg) to your target range of 151–189 g (1.6–2.0 g/kg for 94.5 kg) by adding high-protein vegetarian options like soya chunks, tofu, low-fat paneer, and Greek yogurt.
• Eat your largest, main meal around 17:30–18:30 (containing 40–50 g protein and complex carbs) to fuel heavy leg workouts like squats and Romanian deadlifts before hitting the gym.
• Keep post-workout nutrition light at 21:15—since you return at 21:10 with a 21:30 bedtime, limit intake to 1 scoop of whey in water or 150 g low-fat Greek yogurt (~25 g protein) to avoid digestion issues during sleep.
• Increase daily fibre intake from 5.3 g to at least 25–30 g by serving vegetables, seeds, or whole grains alongside your pre-workout main meal.
